rfi.csv_title: # RFI log — one row per RFI; linked markups/sheets derived from markup.rfi_id

markedset.by_sheet_base_note: By-sheet rows show measured (base) quantities; xN multipliers apply at condition level

xlsx.shapes_note: Per-shape measured quantities — no multiplier or waste; deducts negative; LF on floor/deduct/surface rows is trace reference only (incl. openings) — linear rows alone sum to condition LF
xlsx.floor_room_note: Ordered quantities per floor × room — waste % and xN applied per slice; each floor's rooms reconcile to that floor's shapes. Coverage ceils are per-cell display, not a buy list

marked_set.subject: SUBJECT
marked_set.quantities_note: quantities net of deducts, waste-adjusted where noted
marked_set.nothing_to_export: Nothing to export — no sheet carries takeoffs or markups.

store.stale_tab: OpenTakeoff was updated in another tab — reload this tab to continue.
store.blocked_error: OpenTakeoff is open in another tab with older data — close it or reload.
store.version_error: This tab is running an older OpenTakeoff — reload to update.
store.quota_error: Not enough storage space for this snapshot — delete old snapshots or unused PDFs and try again.
store.pdf_not_found: PDF not found in local store: {{name}}
store.revision_not_found: Revision {{rev}} of {{name}} not found in local store

transition.pick_finishes: Pick the two finishes that meet.
transition.pick_different: Pick two DIFFERENT finishes — a tag does not transition to itself.
transition.own_condition: The transition has to land on its own condition (e.g. T-1) — committing onto {{tag}} would add its LF to one of the finishes it separates.
transition.no_rooms: {{tag}} has no rooms on the open sheets — measure them first (One-Click or Area).
transition.no_scale: {{list}} {{verb}} no scale — a transition is a real length, so calibrate before deriving.
transition.no_shared_sheet: {{a}} and {{b}} have no rooms on the same open sheet — nothing can meet.

detected.no_tags_on_sheet: No room-number tags on this sheet — detection has nothing to seed from.
detected.all_rejected: No room-number tags on this sheet — all {{count}} matching numeral{{suffix}} were rejected as something else.
detected.none_detected_found: No rooms detected: {{count}} room tag{{suffix}} found, {{detail}}.
detected.some_of_tried: {{n}} of {{tried}} room tag{{suffix}} produced a room{{extra}}.
detected.stopped_early_untried: Stopped early — {{count}} room tag{{suffix}} {{verb}} never tried.
detected.other_numerals: {{count}} other numeral{{suffix}} rejected as not a room tag (printed areas, dimensions, drawing numbers, title-block text).
detected.tag_nothing: {{count}} tag{{suffix}} produced nothing — the fill leaked past the room, or landed in dense linework.
detected.tiny_proposal_it: {{count}} proposal{{suffix}} under {{sf}} SF — usually the box drawn around a room tag, not a room. Reject it.
detected.tiny_proposal_them: {{count}} proposal{{suffix}} under {{sf}} SF — usually the box drawn around a room tag, not a room. Reject them.
detected.no_tag_caveat: Only rooms carrying a room-number tag are found — corridors, elevators and vestibules usually carry none and are NOT detected. One-Click those.

voice.reject_unrecognized: Couldn't parse that — try "CPT-1", "waste 7", "label Phase 1", or "note …".
voice.reject_unknown_tag: Couldn't match that tag — say a live condition tag, or a Div-9 code like CPT-2 to create one.
voice.reject_bad_number: Couldn't read the waste number — say 0–100, e.g. "waste 7" or "waste 7.5".
voice.reject_trailing_words: Couldn't parse — extra words after the command. One command at a time.
voice.reject_deixis_no_condition: Couldn't trace — no active condition. Name one, like "CPT-1, this room".
voice.reject_deixis_target: Couldn't aim that — "here"/"this room" places a takeoff, not a note or label clear.
voice.fail_set_waste_no_active: Couldn't set waste — no active condition.
voice.fail_aim_stale: Couldn't place that — aim went stale. Put the cursor on the room and say it again.
voice.fail_aim_sheet: Couldn't place that — aim at a sheet.

stitch.same_sheet: Both clicks landed on the same sheet — click the matching point on the other sheet.

rule.exclude_label: Exclude enclosed regions under {{max}} SF in {{tag}} rooms

ai.not_configured: AI isn't configured — open AI settings first.
ai.timeout_30s: The endpoint took more than 30 seconds — check the model is loaded.
ai.cors_error: Couldn't reach the endpoint — check the URL, and that it allows browser requests (CORS).
ai.no_text: The endpoint replied, but not with text.
ai.timeout_2min: The endpoint took more than 2 minutes — check the model is loaded.
ai.no_json: The endpoint replied, but not with JSON.

id.logo_too_large: Logo too large — use a simpler image
id.read_image_error: Couldn't read that image — PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG please

import.invalid_json: Couldn't import takeoff: that file is not valid JSON.
import.wrong_schema: Couldn't import takeoff: not a takeoff export (expected schema "{{schema}}" — the file export_takeoff or the app writes).

contribute.no_endpoint: No contribution endpoint is configured for this build.

google.not_configured: Google sign-in is not configured for this build.
google.gsi_unavailable: Google Identity Services loaded but oauth2 API is unavailable.
google.gsi_load_failed: Failed to load Google Identity Services.

drive.pdf_not_in_project: PDF not in project sheet set: {{name}}

cloud.load_error: Couldn't read this project's saved takeoff from Drive — reload to retry. ({{detail}})

sweep.ratio_not_finite: Size ratio must be a positive, finite number (seed-sheet px per target-sheet px) — got {{k}}.
sweep.ratio_out_of_band: Size ratio {{k}} is outside the sane band ({{min}} – {{max}}) — that is a larger disagreement than any real sheet pair, so the likelier cause is a wrong scale on one of the two sheets. Check set_scale on both before sweeping across them.
sweep.ratio_all_subpixel: At a {{k}} size ratio every segment of this symbol falls below {{min}} px on the target sheet — there is no linework left to match. Marquee an instance drawn on the target sheet itself.
sweep.no_segments_in_rect: No vector segments sit fully inside the seed rect — marquee tightly around one whole symbol instance (segments crossing the rect edge don't count as the symbol).
sweep.too_many_segments: The seed rect holds {{count}} segments — that is a region, not one symbol instance. Marquee a single symbol.
sweep.exclude_center_scale: excludeCenter is a point on the SEED sheet and means nothing on a target sheet at a different scale — omit it when sweeping across sheets (there is no seed there to shadow).
sweep.symbol_too_small: At a {{scale}} size ratio this symbol is {{footprint}} px across on the target sheet — inside the {{tol}} px matching tolerance, where every placement scores alike and a "match" means nothing. The seed is drawn too large relative to the target for its linework to survive the trip: marquee an instance on the target sheet itself, or count the tag text with sweep_schedule_row.
